# Knovas Assistent

> The one company assistant of the Platform's Workspace, which answers a signed-in person's question only from the passages that person's own search returns, shows only statements whose references it could check, and keeps that person's past chats.

## Identity

| Field | Value |

| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Status | planned |

| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/assistant`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-1` | `RESP-01` | Answers a signed-in person's question from passages the Brain returned to that person, with a checked reference per statement. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/assistant` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-2` |  | Past chats (W-07): what a person asked and the answers as they were shown, with their references, stored in the Platform's own database in new tables only, listed, opened and deleted by their owner only (plan § 5.2). | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/chats.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/migrations/0026_assistant_chats.sql` |

### Not responsible for

- Reading documents any other way than through the person's own search; there is no second way (plan § 5.2, step 2).
- Deciding who may see a document; the Brain's search does, as the signed-in person.
- The search page and the document view; they belong to the Platform's web app.
- Opening a document from a reference; the web app's file routes serve what retrieval handed the person.

### Terms

- reference (a number in an answer that points to a passage retrieved for this person in this chat)
- passage (a hit's verbatim text that the person's search returned, numbered in search order)
- chat (one person's questions and the answers as they were shown, with their references)

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `FU-14` | No Alloy model for POST-02 (the founder, 2026-11-19): the assistant gets document content only through the Brain's search, which enforces access. |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-01` | The check catches a reference number that matches no passage, not one that matches the wrong passage (plan § 7, risks). | The test questions measure it (plan § 11), and the page always shows the passage under the sentence, so the reader sees the evidence itself. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-02` | POST-02 keeps the prompt to what the person's search returns; the search follows the person's rights only where a customer's enforcement is on, and it is off for every tenant today (plan § 3). | No customer is switched to enforcement «Ein» before the Core's end-to-end rights test has passed twice (plan § 8.1, DEC-0082). |
